title: 🔥 Discipline isn’t legalism.
paragraphs:
🔥 Discipline isn’t legalism.
It’s the way warriors keep their oil burning when the nights grow long.
When the world forgets the light — the disciplined still shine.
Because obedience is not bondage — it’s fuel. 🔥

🎬 “The Oil in Dark Seasons”
A story of faith forged in silence, and fire kept alive in secret.

“Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.”
— Psalm 119:105

⚔️ Stay faithful. Stay ready. Stay lit with oil.
